about: The Perecman Firm is a New York City personal injury practice with offices in Manhattan and Corona, Queens.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee basis, with nothing to pay upfront and payment only if the case is won. It publishes a free case review, a 24-hour intake line and service in English and Spanish.

subs.label: Experience
subs.evidence: Mean 22.1 years since admission across 8 of 8 named attorneys (longest 40, shortest 10) · NYS Attorney Registration database

subs.label: Roster verifiability
subs.evidence: 8 of 8 named attorneys matched to the New York register; bar numbers published on the bios

subs.label: Accountability
subs.evidence: member of New York State Trial Lawyers Association, New York State Bar Association, Association of Trial Lawyers of America · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

subs.label: Results published
subs.evidence: The firm publishes no case results we could read

subs.label: Specificity
subs.evidence: 0 case types named; no court or county named, so no result can be looked up

subs.label: Results disclosure
subs.evidence: No prior-results disclaimer on the results page, which the New York advertising rules effectively require

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 735 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 4.9 over 735 reviews → Bayesian 4.89 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 528 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 5 of 5 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-09-04) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 1 of 5 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV fail · no bar numbers on bios · no fee statement · privacy policy · disclaimer · fresh content

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 47 → 90th pct of 76-firm cohort (median 28) 3/3 · 1,277 referring domains, 84th pct 2/2 · 693 organic keywords / 6,822 visits·mo, 79th pct 2/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 1 operational Google Business Profile listing · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · cited in AI answers: 263 citations / 105 pages 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media leave the scale (3 pts)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · Contingency · the fee percentage itself is not published
